QAs.Q1: Have you had difficulty remembering recent conversations?
QAs.A1: Yes, sometimes I forget what my family told me.
QAs.Q2: How confident are you in your memory?
QAs.A2: I am fairly confident, perhaps 7 out of 10.
QAs.Q3: Have you had difficulty finding words?
QAs.A3: Sometimes I know what I want to say, but I cannot find the right word.
QAs.Q4: Have you noticed changes in your ability to manage daily activities?
QAs.A4: I occasionally forget appointments, but I can still manage my shopping and finances.
QAs.Q5: Have you noticed any changes in your attention or concentration?
QAs.A5: I sometimes lose track of what I am doing when there is a lot going on.
